name: watch_ratelimited_surfaces
why: A Slack rate-limit skip holds the watermark and, before this, persisted NOTHING — so the dashboard could not tell a quest was being throttled (a throttling episode was invisible per-quest). The skip must (a) hold the watermark, no dispatch, and (b) emit a gate_watch_ratelimited run-log event carrying quest+watch+type, which the dashboard reads as a transient 'rate limited' flag — symmetric to gate_watch_misconfigured.
